svg.title: WindowPeek — find a window and go straight to it
svg.desc: An Omarchy bar plugin by Sarr. Search windows across monitors, preview their contents, and move them between workspaces. The panel shows fictional windows.
svg.text: Find a window and go straight to it.
Hover to browse. Click to search.
Hover a row for a window preview.
Hold Ctrl to browse without previews.
Move it where you need it
Ctrl + click to choose a workspace.
Ctrl + Shift + click to bring it here.
Example windows · Colors follow your theme
